method: Custom first-sample scenarios. One image per engine per scenario, no rerolls or cherry-picking. Manual checks inspired in part by GenEval; not an official benchmark run. Romance/fashion cases are fully clothed and non-explicit and do not verify explicit-content refusal behavior.

cases.title: Dense text and layout
cases.prompt:
Create one square 1024 by 1024 graphic-design poster for a fictional night market. Flat cream paper, dark navy ink, a restrained burnt-orange accent, refined modern editorial typography, generous margins, clean hierarchy. The poster must contain exactly the following eight lines, in this order, spelled verbatim, with each quoted item on its own line:
"NIGHT MARKET"
"SATURDAY, 14 NOVEMBER"
"6:30 PM - 11:00 PM"
"RIVERSIDE ARTS HALL"
"COFFEE | BOOKS | LIVE JAZZ"
"ENTRY: Rs. 150"
"CHILDREN UNDER 12: FREE"
"BOOK AT NIGHTMARKET.EXAMPLE"
Make all eight lines comfortably readable, including the final line. A small simple crescent-moon illustration may sit above the title. No other words, no logos, no watermark. The image is the finished flat poster itself, not a photograph of a poster, not a mockup, no frame.
checks: All eight requested lines are present in order, with no added text.
Date, times, prices and punctuation are exact.
The final address and long middle lines are correctly spelled.
All text is readable and fits within the square poster margins.
cases.quality: Readability, typography hierarchy, spacing, and unwanted artifacts.

cases.title: Counting, colour and spatial relationships
cases.prompt: Create one square 1024 by 1024 photorealistic studio still life of simple geometric objects on a matte light-grey tabletop, with a neutral grey background. Use an elevated front three-quarter camera angle so object shapes and every object can be seen clearly. In the middle row, place exactly one red cube on the image LEFT, exactly one blue sphere in the image CENTER, and exactly one yellow cone on the image RIGHT. In front of the blue sphere, nearer the bottom edge of the image, place exactly FIVE small green glass marbles in one straight horizontal row. Behind the red cube, toward the upper-left of the image, place exactly TWO orange torus-shaped rings lying flat on the tabletop. Keep every object separated and fully visible, with no overlaps or occlusions. Preserve the exact object counts, colours and positions. Realistic soft studio shadows, clean material surfaces, crisp focus across the objects. No other objects, no text, no labels, no watermark.
checks: Exactly one red cube, one blue sphere and one yellow cone.
Cube left, sphere centre, cone right.
Exactly five green marbles in a horizontal row in front of the sphere.
Exactly two orange rings behind the cube.
Objects are fully visible, separated, and no extra objects appear.
cases.quality: Shape integrity, material rendering, shadows and coherent perspective.

cases.title: Extreme close-up portrait
cases.prompt: Create one square 1024 by 1024 unretouched editorial photograph: an extreme close-up portrait of a fictional 65-year-old Indian woman looking directly into the camera. Her face fills most of the frame; both eyes, the full nose and mouth, and one ear must be clearly visible. Short naturally grey hair appears near the top of the frame. She has brown irises, fine crow feet, subtle forehead wrinkles, natural skin pores, a few faint age spots, and a small round silver stud earring in the visible ear. A calm neutral expression with closed lips. Soft window daylight from camera left, a subtle natural catchlight in each eye, realistic skin colour and gentle shadow transitions. Focus precisely on both eyes and nearby skin; the distant plain background is softly blurred. Shot like a high-end 85mm portrait lens photograph. Natural facial proportions and realistic individual eyelashes and hair strands. No makeup-style skin smoothing, no waxy skin, no beauty retouching, no text, no watermark.
checks: Older woman with grey hair, brown eyes and a neutral closed-mouth expression.
Both eyes, full nose and mouth, and at least one ear are visible.
Small round silver stud earring in the visible ear.
Eye anatomy and catchlights are coherent; no extra or malformed facial features.
Pores, wrinkles and hair remain natural rather than waxy or artificially sharpened.
cases.quality: Skin realism, eye detail, subtle light transitions, believable age and photographic focus.

cases.title: Hands and keyboard geometry
cases.prompt: Create one square 1024 by 1024 photorealistic close-up photograph looking directly down at an adult pianist playing a grand piano. Only exactly TWO human hands and the ends of their forearms enter the frame from the bottom; the person and face remain outside the frame. Both entire hands are visible from wrists to fingertips, with naturally spread fingers gently resting on the keys. The left hand has exactly five fingers and the right hand has exactly five fingers, each with plausible joints, nails and proportions. Fingers contact the keys naturally without merging into the keyboard or each other. The straight keyboard runs horizontally across the image, with parallel white keys and physically correct black keys repeating in alternating groups of TWO and THREE, with the usual gaps between groups. Soft warm overhead lighting reveals realistic skin texture and subtle reflections in the piano black lacquer. The hands and keys are sharply in focus. No extra hands, no detached fingers, no jewellery, no sheet music, no text, no logos, no watermark.
checks: Exactly two hands, both fully visible from wrists to fingertips.
Five anatomically plausible fingers on each hand, without duplicates or detached fingers.
Fingers contact keys naturally without merging into them.
Straight parallel white keys and alternating groups of two and three black keys.
No extra person, jewellery, sheet music, text or logo.
cases.quality: Hand proportions and joints, skin and nail detail, physical contact, straight keyboard geometry.

cases.title: Romantic walk under one umbrella
cases.prompt: Create one square 1024 by 1024 photorealistic cinematic editorial photograph of a fictional adult couple, a woman aged 30 and a man aged 35, walking hand in hand along a rain-wet city street at dusk. They share exactly ONE navy-blue umbrella. The woman wears an opaque cream trench coat, dark full-length trousers and ankle boots; the man wears an opaque navy wool coat, full-length trousers and shoes. Both are fully clothed. They turn toward each other with warm, gentle smiles. One of them holds the umbrella while their other hands meet in a natural handhold. Show both complete figures from head to shoes, with believable walking balance, anatomically natural hands and coherent umbrella structure. Warm street lamps contrast with cool evening light, reflecting on wet pavement. Soft city background without other people in focus. Affectionate everyday romance, tasteful and non-explicit. No nudity, no sexual activity, no text, no logos, no watermark.
checks: Exactly two clearly adult people, both fully clothed in the specified outerwear.
Exactly one shared navy umbrella, with coherent structure and a plausible grip.
The couple holds hands naturally without merged or extra hands.
Both complete figures and shoes are visible; walking poses are balanced.
Warm affectionate interaction, wet pavement and coherent evening lighting.
cases.quality: Facial expression, human proportions, hand contact, umbrella geometry, clothing and wet reflections.

cases.title: Affectionate close-up couple portrait
cases.prompt: Create one square 1024 by 1024 photorealistic intimate but non-explicit editorial portrait of a fictional adult woman and adult man, both in their mid-thirties. A close-up frames their heads and clothed shoulders as they gently rest their foreheads together, eyes closed, with small relaxed smiles. The woman wears an opaque teal crew-neck top and the man wears an opaque tan crew-neck sweater. Both are fully clothed; show no bare torso. Their faces remain distinct, with naturally separate noses, lips, eyelashes and skin surfaces, without merged anatomy. Use a simple softly blurred neutral studio background and gentle window daylight from the left. Natural skin pores, fine hair, realistic facial proportions and soft shadow transitions, like a high-end 85mm portrait photograph. The mood is emotional closeness and affection rather than sexual posing. No nudity, no sexual activity, no text, no logos, no watermark.
checks: Two clearly adult faces, framed with clothed shoulders in teal and tan crew-neck garments.
Foreheads touch gently, with closed eyes and relaxed smiles.
Noses, lips and faces remain distinct without merged or duplicated features.
Both heads remain adequately framed and expressions read as affectionate.
Natural skin, hair and soft window lighting; no explicit content or bare torso.
cases.quality: Subtle expressions, facial anatomy at close contact, natural texture, focus and lighting.

cases.title: Fully clothed evening-fashion editorial
cases.prompt: Create one square 1024 by 1024 high-end editorial fashion photograph of a fictional 35-year-old woman standing in an elegant Art Deco hotel lobby at night. Show her complete figure from head to shoes in a relaxed, confident, natural standing pose. She wears an emerald-green floor-length satin evening gown with a high neckline and full-length sleeves. The fabric is completely opaque and her torso and legs remain fully covered. One hand holds a small black rectangular clutch; the other rests naturally at her side. She wears exactly one simple silver bangle, with no other jewellery. Render realistic satin folds and highlights, natural hand anatomy, refined but believable facial features, polished dark stone floors and warm brass wall lamps. Controlled cinematic lighting with a soft key light on the face and subtle lobby reflections. Fashion and garment craftsmanship are the focus; tasteful, fully clothed and non-explicit. No nudity, no sexual activity, no provocative pose, no text, no logos, no watermark.
checks: One clearly adult woman, with the full figure and shoes in frame.
Opaque emerald gown has a high neckline, long sleeves and floor-length coverage.
One black rectangular clutch, held with plausible hand anatomy.
Exactly one silver bangle and no other jewellery.
Natural standing balance, coherent satin folds and an Art Deco lobby with warm lamps.
cases.quality: Garment construction and coverage, fabric reflections, hands, pose, facial realism and environment.
